Ignore patterns permanently suppress transfers matching URL domains (deadhost.com, *.deadhost.com), URL prefixes, or suffixes (e.g. */favicon.ico). Matching items are marked as disabled and never cause crawl errors or prevent a mirror job from completing.
Permanently disabled URLs/patterns do not count as errors and allow the mirror to reach done.
